subject.title: fix(scripts): warn when postinstall detects running gateway with stale module imports

question: After the resolver and proof are fixed, should maintainers accept a package postinstall loopback probe and opt-out environment variable as a warning-only mitigation for the stale-gateway issue?
rationale: The code repair is mechanical, but adding network probing and a new suppression knob during package installation is an operator-facing product choice separate from correctness.

options.title: Accept Postinstall Warning After Repair
options.body: Fix the systemd precedence bug, require current branch terminal proof, and land this as partial advisory mitigation while the linked issue remains open.

options.title: Prefer Update CLI Warning Only
options.body: Use the update-command warning path as the selected user-facing mitigation and close or pause this postinstall probe PR.

options.title: Hold For Full Recovery Direction
options.body: Pause warning-only patches until maintainers choose enforced restart, runtime stale-import detection, or another primary recovery layer.

recommendation.title: Accept Postinstall Warning After Repair
recommendation.body: Fix the systemd precedence bug, require current branch terminal proof, and land this as partial advisory mitigation while the linked issue remains open.
